_for: ㅋㅋ상회 AI 릴스 4개(보내기용) 그림 11장 (2026-11-22 01시). 글씨는 humor-cards에서 직접 얹는다.
style: Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, signs with writing, or logos anywhere in the image. Original characters only, not resembling any real person or existing franchise.

prompts.name: r1_readignore
prompts.prompt: Cute chubby round animal character in a soft pastel Korean emoticon illustration style, thick soft outlines, big expressive face, plain light cream background, centered, full body. A fluffy cat lies lazily on its back on a small sofa, holding a smartphone above its face with a completely bored, dead-eyed expression, while many little red notification dots float around the phone. It clearly sees the messages and ignores them.

prompts.name: r2_before
prompts.prompt: Soft colored Korean webtoon illustration, clean lineart, expressive exaggerated faces, warm lighting. A young Korean woman in her bedroom, two hours before meeting friends, holding up a cute outfit in front of a mirror, beaming with excitement, sparkles around her, makeup kit open, very energetic and happy.

prompts.name: r2_after
prompts.prompt: Soft colored Korean webtoon illustration, clean lineart, expressive exaggerated faces, warm lighting. The same young Korean woman, now lying in bed fully under a blanket with only her face and hands out, makeup only half done, hair messy, typing on her phone with a guilty, sly, slightly fake-sick expression. The outfit is thrown on the chair. Evening light.

prompts.name: r3_compliment

A young Korean man sitting at a cafe table, smiling a bit too nervously and sweetly at his girlfriend across the table, small sweat drop on his temple, hands clasped, obviously hiding something. Only he is in focus, upper body shot.

A young Korean woman at a cafe table narrowing her eyes in deep suspicion, one eyebrow raised, arms crossed, leaning forward like a detective interrogating someone. Dramatic shadow over her eyes, comedic intensity. Upper body shot.

prompts.name: r4_call

A young Korean man in his 20s lying on a sofa in a small apartment, casually talking on the phone with a relaxed lazy smile, waving his hand dismissively as if saying 'no thanks, I'm fine'. Simple cozy room.

prompts.name: r4_table
prompts.prompt: Soft colored Korean webtoon illustration, clean lineart, expressive exaggerated faces, warm lighting. A Korean home dining table absolutely overflowing with food: a huge pot of stew, piles of side dishes, grilled fish, a mountain of rice, fried chicken, fruit, dishes stacked on dishes. A smiling Korean mother in an apron proudly presents it with both hands. The same young man stands frozen in shock with his mouth open. Warm kitchen light, comedic exaggeration.
